client: EVE Online V24.01 (build 3619879), the real client at ~/Library/Application Support/EVE Online/SharedCache/tq/EVE.app
rules: Every journey drives the REAL client against a locally started EvoMu server. Mocks, replayed packets, and server-side shortcuts don't count.
Automation may use in-client Python (client-bridge) or OS-level UI automation, but every game action must go through the client's own UI or service calls, exactly as a player's would.
Each journey records evidence (screenshots and/or client log excerpts plus server log excerpts) in result.json.
The server log for the whole run must contain zero UnimplementedRPC and zero panics. Client logs must contain zero Python tracebacks or EXCEPTION lines.

journeys.title: Launch and log in
journeys.steps: Start the client pointed at EvoMu, authenticate through emulated SSO/launcher tokens, pass the machoNet handshake, and reach character selection with the account's characters listed.

journeys.title: Create a character
journeys.steps: Create a new character for each of the 4 races (bloodline, ancestry, school, paperdoll, portrait). The character appears in its school station with its starter ship, skills and ISK.

journeys.title: Station services
journeys.steps: Docked: open the hangars, inventory, fitting, market, industry, agency, character sheet, skills, wallet, journal, corporation, people & places, mail, notifications, calendar and NES store windows. All of them populate with no errors.

journeys.title: Fit a ship
journeys.steps: Buy modules on the market, fit them (CPU/PG/slot validation), online them, load ammo, save and load a fitting, and assemble/repackage a ship. Fitting attributes match dogma.

journeys.title: Undock and navigate
journeys.steps: Undock, use the overview, approach/orbit/keep at range, align, warp to a celestial and to a bookmark, set a route, autopilot through 3 stargates, and dock at the destination. Destiny updates are smooth and the camera shows celestials.

journeys.title: Chat
journeys.steps: Local, corp, fleet and private channels: messages appear for a second connected client, and member lists update on jump/dock.

journeys.title: Two players
journeys.steps: Two clients in the same system see each other on the overview and in space, see each other's actions (warp, modules), and can trade directly.

journeys.title: Skill training
journeys.steps: Queue skills, wait while time advances, and see the queue progress and OnSkillTrained arrive. Use skill injectors and extractors, buy and apply a skill plan, and use attribute remap, implants and boosters.

journeys.title: Market
journeys.steps: Place, modify and cancel buy and sell orders, fill them against another player and against NPC-seeded orders, and check the broker fees/taxes, wallet journal, transactions and market history.

journeys.title: Contracts
journeys.steps: Item exchange, auction with bids, and courier contracts (with collateral, delivery and expiry) between two clients.

journeys.title: Mining
journeys.steps: Warp to an asteroid belt, survey scan, mine ore, ice and gas with lasers/harvesters and mining drones into the ore hold, use a mining crystal, deplete an asteroid, check the mining ledger, compress the ore, then dock and reprocess it with skill-based yields.

journeys.title: PvE combat
journeys.steps: Fight belt rats and an anomaly site: lock targets, cycle weapons with capacitor and heat, take and deal damage per dogma, kill the NPCs, loot and salvage the wrecks, and receive the bounty.

journeys.title: Missions
journeys.steps: Take security, distribution, mining and storyline missions from agents in the Agency; complete them in mission pockets with acceleration gates; collect rewards, LP and standings; use the LP store.

journeys.title: Exploration
journeys.steps: Launch probes and scan down a data site, a relic site and a combat signature. Hack containers with the hacking minigame and loot them. Use D-scan.

journeys.title: Wormholes and filaments
journeys.steps: Scan down and jump a wormhole (mass and lifetime limits), then run an abyssal filament (timer, rooms, loot) and a Pochven/Triglavian filament.

journeys.title: Ship loss
journeys.steps: Insure a ship, then lose it to NPCs and to another player. Check the wreck/loot drop, pod ejection, killmail, insurance payout, medical clone respawn and security-status/crimewatch effects (suspect/criminal/CONCORD in high-sec).

journeys.title: Clones
journeys.steps: Install a jump clone, clone-jump with implants, check the cooldown, and set the home station.

journeys.title: Industry
journeys.steps: Run manufacturing, ME/TE research, copying, invention and a reaction in station and in a structure. Check job costs, timers and delivery.

journeys.title: Planetary industry
journeys.steps: Build a colony with extractors, factories, links and routes. Wait while time advances, see the product appear, and export it through a customs office/skyhook with tax.

journeys.title: Corporation
journeys.steps: Create a corporation, invite and accept a second character, set roles/titles, rent an office, use corp hangars and wallet divisions, set tax, use corp projects/opportunities, and create an alliance.

journeys.title: Fleet
journeys.steps: Form a fleet, set wings/squads and roles, broadcast, fleet warp, use command bursts, advertise in the fleet finder and set the MOTD.

journeys.title: Upwell structures
journeys.steps: Anchor, online and fuel a citadel; fit service modules; set access profiles; dock and use services; reinforce it through the timers; check asset safety.

journeys.title: Sovereignty and faction warfare
journeys.steps: Equinox sov: hub, upgrades, power/workforce, skyhook. Enlist in faction warfare, capture a complex, see the system contest update, and receive LP.

journeys.title: Agency, daily goals and events
journeys.steps: Daily goals, opportunities/AIR career program, seasonal events and corp goals progress and pay out through the Quasar/public-gateway services.

journeys.title: Cosmetics and store
journeys.steps: Apply SKINs, SKINR/paragon designs, emblems and corp logos. Use the PLEX vault and NES store purchase flows, and multiple-character training.

journeys.title: Mail and notifications
journeys.steps: Send/receive mail, mailing lists, labels, the notification feed and calendar events between two clients.

journeys.title: ESI
journeys.steps: An external HTTP client obtains an SSO token for a character and calls ESI endpoints in every tag group. The results match the in-client state, including scope enforcement and caching headers.

journeys.title: Persistence and downtime
journeys.steps: Run a scheduled downtime: the server restarts, every piece of state (items, wallets, skills, orders, structures, PI, timers) survives, belts respawn, and daily resets happen.

journeys.title: GM tools
journeys.steps: A GM account uses the slash commands (spawn, create item, give skills, teleport, heal, set attribute, kick/ban). The commands are role-gated: a normal account is refused.
